snippet.title: Sail Forth: Out Now on Nintendo Switch 2 + Battle for Croaker Command
snippet.description:
Sail Forth just released on the Nintendo Switch 2 -  a completely free upgrade from the Nintendo Switch version.

Along with it comes the largest free update yet:  Battle for Croaker Command, available on all platforms. Work alongside the Croaker Command Corps to build a base, including guard towers, cantina, fish pond, bait shop, and core extractor. But beware, the Tekk Clan has a new boss waiting: the Tekk Destroyer. Defending your base will be no easy feat, but doing so will reward you with a new, powerful ship: The Croaker Flagship.

Nintendo Switch: https://www.qag.io/SailForthSwitch
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/sail-forth/9n2f6cq1vl78
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/234318/
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031460/Sail_Forth
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/sail-forth-51847e
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/sail_forth
